text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...I won.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I... won. I claimed victory in the GⅠ that 
crowns the king of sprinters... the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: ...Not bad at all, Kawakami Princess.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Haha, looks like the changing of the guard 
is finally here! That takes a load off 
King Halo's shoulders, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(...If I won, that means King-san 
is............)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Why are you looking down?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, King-san. I-I'm so sorry. I... toward 
you—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You weren't entertaining foolish thoughts 
like... having hurt King's feelings, were 
you?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ngh!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Don't underestimate this. This is the 
world of competition. A place where you 
crush someone else's dreams to make your 
own come true.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
No, even outside the competitive world, it 
takes resolve to express who you are.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
“—Just as there is only one King Halo, not 
everyone can be the exact same person.”

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
King... why did you lose...? I was so sure 
you were going to win...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Means your peak has passed, right? It's 
embarrassing. Stop acting out so 
selfishly. Do it for the sake of the next 
generation.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, unsightly, isn't it? —From your 
perspective, that is.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I take pride in having run that 
race. I have no regrets about being 
selfish whatsoever."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Because making this choice is what makes 
me who I am!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much you tell me to be 
ashamed of myself, I will never be ashamed 
of who I am.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I might reflect on the times I've acted 
selfishly, but reflecting with regret on 
simply being myself? What kind of foolish 
notion is that?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...I am King. King Halo. A first-rate 
Umamusume who lives as none other than 
herself."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...King-san.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: U-Um... King-san!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Kawakami-san.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Please excuse me for earlier...! I... 
thought that you—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...If you think what you did was shameful, 
you're free to reflect on it. But...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You must not fear hurting someone with 
your actions, nor fear being rejected by 
others.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Always listen to your own heart, not to 
others.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Is this an act to be ashamed of? Or is it 
an act befitting myself, one I can be 
proud of?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
If you confuse being selfish with being 
true to yourself, you won't be able to 
prove anything.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Selfishness, and staying true to 
oneself...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if the day comes where we compete 
again. I will still crush you with 
everything I've got."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I will not hold back against anyone. I 
believe that staying true to myself is how 
I show respect to those I challenge."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I won't lose next time, Kawakami-san.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
choice_data_list:
...Do you know how to paint your "ideal" 
now?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, of course. The answer is 
already... right here.

And a few days later, Kawakami Princess 
came to me with a certain proposal.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Before the Takamatsunomiya Kinen, 
King-san asked me, 'Can you hold your head 
high with pride?'

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Is this an action I can take pride in? Is 
this truly like me?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why I don't want to be 
selfish; I want to charge ahead true to 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: No matter how I am seen by anyone.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. About the Fan Appreciation 
Festival next month... I'd really love to 
perform on this stage.

What Kawakami Princess showed me was a 
certain stage plan.

""Looking back on last year's Tiara route! 
A joint talk show featuring radiant 
Umamusume!""

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who competed together last 
year... and their fans will apparently be 
gathering as well.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Refusing to take the stage for such a 
reason would be unbefitting of a princess.

Her gaze was resolute, as if she had made 
up her mind about something.

Yet deep down, she was wavering. Trembling 
slightly, but rallying herself to grow 
stronger.
